scope: Planning-only recommendation for a source-bound JEV plus W1-W5 engineering work-plan projection. No experiment, runtime execution, result, CR/FCL promotion, or HSWM efficacy is asserted.

official_standards.title: RDF 1.1 Concepts and Abstract Syntax
official_standards.plan_scope: Stable RDF graph/dataset and term model for the existing deterministic N-Quads projection. RDF describes a structural graph; it does not establish the truth, execution, or causal efficacy of its nodes.

official_standards.title: RDF 1.2 Concepts and Abstract Data Model
official_standards.plan_scope: Candidate-only comparison lane. It adds triple terms and RDF version announcement, but does not justify a stable-plan migration or a claim that provenance/reification changes evidence status.

official_standards.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
official_standards.plan_scope: Reuse derivation links for source-bound plan statements and, only after a real occurrence, Entity/Activity/Agent provenance. A planned work package, acceptance criterion, or future output is not itself a prov:Activity.

official_standards.title: Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL)
official_standards.plan_scope: Stable Core validation for local plan vocabulary: cardinality, datatype, status enumerations, typed relations, and qualified task membership. SHACL conformance is structural only.

official_standards.title: SHACL 1.2 Core
official_standards.plan_scope: Experimental comparison only. Do not put draft-only constraints in the stable validator or label them as interoperable acceptance evidence.

official_standards.title: SPARQL 1.1 Query Language
official_standards.plan_scope: Stable SELECT/ASK review queries, including property paths for dependency closure and cycles. A query result is an inspection of the projected snapshot, not an outcome measurement.

official_standards.title: SPARQL 1.2 Query Language
official_standards.plan_scope: Experimental only; SPARQL 1.1 remains the stable query contract. No future plan may require draft syntax without a separately pinned qualification.

plan_projection.reuse: Keep its source-bound plan/bundle split, one schema-relative responsibility owner per WORK_PACKAGE, INPUT_CONTRACT, EXPECTED_ARTIFACT, ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION, PLAN_DECISION, AUDIT_REQUIREMENT and ENGINEERING_SOURCE roles, explicit dependencies, immutable source hashes, and create-only snapshot generation.

shacl.reuse: Reuse WorkPackageShape, ExpectedArtifactShape, AcceptanceCriterionShape, PlanDecisionShape, EngineeringSourceShape and ToolProfileShape. Keep planned artifacts NOT_PRODUCED, criteria NOT_RUN and decisions OPEN until an independently bound result exists.

native_tools.reuse: Use the existing v2 RDF/N-Quads projection, SHACL validator and SPARQL query runner. Its accepted stable qualification is RDF 1.1 N-Quads; the pinned RDF 1.2 N-Quads profile is explicitly experimental. No package, adapter or live-KG path is needed for plan creation.

local_vocabulary_boundary.rule: Local role/status/CR/FCL/W identifiers are HSWM plan vocabulary carried by the RDF projection; they are not asserted to be W3C vocabulary or PROV classes.

nonvacuous_shacl_guidance: Retain class-targeted shapes for every local plan role, but add a root-targeted plan shape to the fresh plan root so an empty graph cannot pass merely because it has no role:WORK_PACKAGE focus node.

The root shape should require source_ref, source_sha256, responsibility_owner, claim_ceiling, at least five r:HAS_CONCEPT values qualified as role:WORK_PACKAGE, and one source-bound ENGINEERING_SOURCE for the plan document/catalog.

For each required W1-W5 identifier, use a named target node or one explicit qualified value constraint and require task_id, PLANNED status, owner role, input, output, acceptance criterion, source, audit requirement, and the specified DEPENDS_ON edges. Do not rely on sh:targetClass alone for required task existence.

Keep actual-evidence requirements conditional on PRODUCED/ACCEPTED, PASS/FAIL, or SATISFIED/NOT_SATISFIED states. Add a plan-specific negative query that reports HAS_ACTUAL_EVIDENCE on NOT_PRODUCED, NOT_RUN, or OPEN nodes, because the reusable shape permits these planned states.
future_plan_invariants: All W1-W5 nodes are PLANNED; all proposed empirical artifacts are NOT_PRODUCED; all empirical criteria are NOT_RUN; no plan node represents an executed experiment.

Design tasks may run in parallel. W2 efficacy needs qualified W1; W3 read measurement needs qualified W1 while its learning claim remains separate W2; W4 joint measurement may run alongside W2 after read readiness; W5 learning requires qualified W2, W3 and W4. W2 retains NO_CHANGE and all assigned worlds in intent-to-treat.

Every work package has exactly one local responsibility owner and one responsibility-role node, typed input/output/criterion/source/audit links, an explicit failure or reroute condition, and a source hash checked outside SPARQL.
W3 compares distinct actual reads under the same admissible-information and total-cost budget; it must not encode active reading as free extra information.

A work package cannot become COMPLETE unless its output is ACCEPTED, its criterion PASS, its dependencies COMPLETE, required decisions SATISFIED, and each such terminal assertion has actual source-bound evidence.

No planned node is typed prov:Activity. When an occurrence later happens, model the occurrence separately with PROV-O and link its resulting evidence to the plan; do not rewrite the historical plan node into an activity.

query_reuse_and_additions.expectation: Returns only PLANNED tasks whose dependencies are COMPLETE and start decisions SATISFIED; planning-only W1-W5 should not be reported ready if their empirical prerequisites remain open.
Inspect W1-W5 closure and require zero cycle rows.
Every task returns the owner/role/input/output/criterion/source/requirement contract and zero audit requirements are uncovered.
Open decisions remain visible; premature-complete rows must be zero.
Returns zero for any plan that declares a TOOL_PROFILE; omit tool nodes rather than inventing pins.
Returns each W task with its direct dependency IDs and flags any missing or extra edge against the explicit invariant.
Returns NOT_PRODUCED/NOT_RUN/OPEN nodes that nevertheless have HAS_ACTUAL_EVIDENCE; expected zero.
Returns any role:WORK_PACKAGE or planned artifact also typed prov:Activity; expected zero.
Recompute every ENGINEERING_SOURCE SHA-256 and artifact binding; SPARQL can test presence/typing but cannot recompute file bytes.

limits: RDF/SHACL/SPARQL validate or query a static projection. They do not execute the local LLM operator, validate outcome independence, establish semantic revision, prove read sufficiency, prove joint-law preservation, or establish two-scale cognition.
PROV-O records provenance structure. It does not confer truth, permission, causal credit, owner authority, experiment completion, or CR/FCL promotion.
RDF 1.2, SHACL 1.2 and SPARQL 1.2 are not stable-plan dependencies at the reviewed dates.
